name: Disagreements
overview: Scripture acknowledges that human understanding and direction are limited, as Jeremiah reminds us that man cannot direct his own steps. True agreement is essential for unity, as Amos emphasizes that two cannot walk together unless they are agreed. Jesus teaches the importance of withholding judgment to avoid being judged ourselves and calls believers to love one another as He has loved us, fostering harmony even amid differences. Knowing and living in the truth brings freedom, and recognizing our place as servants under Christ helps maintain humility in relationships, guiding us through disagreements with grace and love.
